messages:
Ashley (PM): FYI — ACME asked for per-project API keys + rotation guarantees for chat, embeddings, and rerank. They called this a blocker for Dedicated <> Hosted parity.
Jamie (Sales): They need: scoped keys, zero-downtime rotation, model allowlist per key, and per-key quotas. Also want usage visible in console.
Ryan (Eng): Note: we have project scoping in Dedicated infra, but hosted API doesn't surface project-bound keys. Main work: routing by key -> project, billing tags, and rotation semantics.
Priya (Security): Rotation semantics matter. We should support atomic rotate with overlap window, audit events, and a revocation list. KMS/HSM integration for secret wrapping.
Ashley (PM): Launch criteria suggestion from sales: (1) rotation endpoint w/ overlap, (2) console view for keys + last-used, (3) audit trail for create/rotate/revoke, (4) ability to tie key to a project id.
Ryan (Eng): Proposal for v1: expose API key metadata with a `project_id` label, implement `POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate` returning new key, and support key states `active|revoked|rotated`. Rotation flow uses 24h overlap by default. Example:```json
POST /v1/keys/kt_abc123/rotate
{ "grace_window": 86400 }
```
Priya (Security): 24h default okay but allow configurable grace_window. Must ensure rotated keys are tracked and cannot be re-used. Emit events: `key.created`, `key.rotated`, `key.revoked` to our audit stream.
Jamie (Sales): Also ask for endpoint-scoping: restrict key to embeddings-only or chat-only, plus model allowlist (e.g., allow `redwood-4` but not experimental variants). Customer will use this to limit blast radius.
Ryan (Eng): Endpoint/model scoping means changes to our routing and policy checks. For streaming chat and tool-calls, we need lightweight validation in proxy to avoid latency impact.
Marta (DevEx): Need SDK & console UX: rotate button, show active keys, created_at, last_used, binding to project dropdown, and a bulk rotate flow for org admins.
mira-bot: Created ticket INF-4987: "API key rotation + project-bound keys (v1)" assigned to @Ryan.
Ashley (PM): Prioritization: if we can't land full policy engine this quarter, split: v1 = project labels + rotation API + console key list; v2 = endpoint scoping + model allowlists + per-key quotas + admin bulk flows.
Ryan (Eng): Rough estimates: v1 = 3 sprints (routing, keystore changes, rotation endpoint, console list), v2 = 4 sprints (policy engine hooks, proxies, quota enforcement).
Priya (Security): Compliance checklist: KMS integration, audit retention policy, exportable audit logs for customers, and SOC/ISO playbooks. Legal needs copy for key handling in SLA.
Jamie (Sales): I'll communicate phased plan to ACME and ask if they can accept v1 with a roadmap to v2.
Ashley (PM): Action items: I will draft PRD (include launch criteria above), Ryan to attach rough tech design + risks, Priya to list security reqs, Marta to mock console screens.
Ryan (Eng): Risk note: revocation across caches (edge proxies, KV caches) could take up to N seconds for TTL expiry — we should document worst-case.
Priya (Security): Also require telemetry: per-key last 10 IPs used, and detection for anomalous cross-project usage.
Marta (DevEx): UX note: show "rotate" with a preview of downtime impact (should be none) and show policy labels.
Ashley (PM): Good thread. I'll circulate the PRD this afternoon and tag ACME's AM. :thumbsup:
